aboutText: With over 15 years of experience serving Melbourne and its surrounding suburbs, Core Electrical & Automation Pty Ltd has built a reputation for reliable, high-quality electrical work you can trust. Our licensed team specialises in everything from residential rewiring and switchboard upgrades to cutting-edge home automation and commercial fit-outs — all completed to the highest Australian standards.
